source: AfterMath analysis of flagged AfterHour accounts and public Telegram channels
disclaimer: Channels and accounts here are flagged for investigation, not a finding of fraud. Flag list curated by https://telegramscammers.com.
small_sample_warning: Based on 1146 scored option callouts posted 2026-06-08 to 2026-10-13 from public channels. Scores are hold-to-expiry intrinsic value against the entry price the channel quoted, with no slippage or fees; most are same-day index and large-cap options. Channels usually quote early exits, which are not what is scored here. A limited sample, not a settled rate, and not advice.
